description: dark phonk trap, cyberpunk phonk, glitch trap, 66 BPM, F# minor, male vocals, pitched-down menacing flow, chopped call-and-response chant hook, chromatic screwed ad-libs, heavy distorted 808 slides, RGB-split glitch hi-hats, stuttering glitch snares, massive cathedral reverb, neon cityscape ambience, distant sirens, rain on neon, chromatic-aberration shimmer, gradual pitch descent, cyber-horror atmosphere, ominous, anthemic, catchy
lyrics:
[Intro]
[whispered] City of souls...
[whispered] Nobody makes it home

[Verse 1]
Pink phantom over the sprawl, I hover low
Antenna horns pick up the signal from your soul
Death don't wear black no more, it's bathed in neon glow
Reaping in a city where the living lost control
Towers start to tremble every time I manifest
RGB corruption bleeding through the CMYK mess
They thought the end was darkness — I arrive fluorescent
Magenta executioner, chromatic and possessed

[Pre-Chorus]
Count 'em down, count 'em down, the meter's in the red
Every heartbeat's a download and I own the thread

[Chorus]
Neon reaper (reaper), glitchin' through your dreams
Neon reaper (reaper), nothin's what it seems
City full of souls but nobody hears the screams
Neon reaper (reaper), tearin' at the seams
Reaper in RGB — I paint the city dead
Neon reaper (reaper), livin' in your head

[Verse 2]
[pitched-down] Corruption in the concrete like a digital decay
Pixel bones and fractal horns, I light up the prey
Death became aesthetic in the cybernetic age
Souls in megabytes, I upload 'em to the rage
404 on your future, I'm the error in the code
Reaper-dot-e-x-e runnin' every time the streetlight glowed
Neon halo flicker, static crown upon my head
Press start to keep breathing — but the continue screen is dead

[Chorus]
Neon reaper (reaper), glitchin' through your dreams
Neon reaper (reaper), nothin's what it seems
City full of souls but nobody hears the screams
Neon reaper (reaper), tearin' at the seams
Reaper in RGB — I paint the city dead
Neon reaper (reaper), livin' in your head

[Breakdown]
[glitch] Re—re—reaper... neon... error... corrupt...
[glitch] city—souls—loading—
[whispered] death dot e-x-e

[Silence]
...

[Bass Drop]
[808 slide]

[Outro]
The city never sleeps
[whispered] 'cause I'm always watching
[fading] Neon reaper... city of souls...
